jobs.title: Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering

$250,000 - $275,000+ base + equity | San Francisco Bay Area | Predominantly in-person

SODA has partnered with a neurotechnology company developing software and medical technology used in brain health treatment. The first generation of the technology works and is already being used with patients. Your challenge is to decide what comes next.

This is a senior technical role for someone who wants architectural ownership, not a calendar dominated by people management. You’ll inherit a complex system spanning brain imaging, cloud infrastructure, distributed processing, algorithms and medical devices, then define its next generation.

The Opportunity

The initial application focuses on depression. The longer term technical challenge is building a modular architecture capable of supporting many future applications across neurological and psychiatric conditions.

You’ll work directly with the founders, remain close to the engineering and lead an initial team of around five engineers. The architecture isn’t predetermined. You’ll understand what exists, decide what needs to change and lead the work to build it.

What You'll Do

Build a technical understanding of the system from brain scan to stimulation
Define the architecture for the next generation of the technology
Architect an MVP designed to support multiple future clinical applications
Turn architectural decisions into a clear engineering roadmap
Lead execution while remaining close to difficult technical problems
Guide an initial engineering team of around five people
Partner with founders on major technical and product decisions

What You'll Bring

Essential:

Deep software engineering and architectural problem-solving ability
Experience designing complex cloud, distributed or data-intensive systems
Technical leadership experience while remaining close to engineering
Ability to understand interconnected systems and make sound architectural trade-offs

Desirable:

Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux and Python
Exposure to regulated software, healthcare or medical devices
Experience with imaging, MRI/DICOM, scientific computing or C#

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. The right mindset matters as much as the right CV.

What's In It For You

$275,000+ base salary plus equity
Ownership of an architecture that hasn't yet been defined
Direct technical partnership with the founding team
Complex engineering spanning software, compute, imaging and physical devices
Technology already being used to support patient treatment

Interested?

If you’re a Principal Engineer ready for broader technical ownership, or a Director who still wants to engineer, this role sits deliberately between those paths.

You’ll inherit something that works. The opportunity is to understand it, challenge it and architect what it becomes next.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Safety
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord only works at our scale if people feel safe showing up — and building the systems that make that possible is exactly what our Safety engineering org does.

We classify content, route reports, make and audit enforcement decisions, and build the tools our operations partners use to handle everything automation doesn't. The work is a mix of deep backend infrastructure, AI-driven automation, and tight collaboration with the people who do nuanced review. As Discord grows into new surfaces like commerce and ads, the platform we build matters more.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead Safety Infrastructure Engineering at Discord. The org is roughly 20 engineers across two teams with two EM direct reports. You'll report to the senior Director of Safety and work closely with T&S Operations, Safety ML, Safety Product, Legal, Policy, Security, and Core Tech.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow two engineering teams covering our safety backend: the decision platform, classification systems, content understanding, intake and routing pipelines, and observability
Drive the automation roadmap with Safety ML. Decide where AI belongs in the loop, where humans still win, and hold the line on quality, latency, and cost
Own the queue routing and internal tooling our ops teams and vendor partners rely on, and partner with T&S Operations on golden sets, QA, appeals, and evals that turn operational signal into better systems
Consolidate fragmented systems onto infra and set the bar for engineering quality: on-call, incident response, technical review, and ownership
Hire, coach, and grow senior leaders

Who You Are

5+ years as a software engineer with a strong backend and distributed systems background, and 5+ years as an EM including 2+ years managing managers. Experience running 20+ engineers through multiple EMs
Strong infrastructure instincts. You can hold your own in architecture discussions on event-driven systems, service migrations, and platform design
Fluent in AI and ML systems enough to partner credibly with an ML org and make good calls about where automation belongs in a decision pipeline
Experienced working closely with ops or human-in-the-loop teams. You get the rhythm of QA, calibration, appeals, and ground-truth work, and build tools that respect the people using them
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a history of partnering effectively across engineering, ML, data science, policy, legal, and product teams.
Practical about throughput, vendor management, and unit economics
An empathetic and experienced recruiter and coach. People you've managed want to work with you again

Bonus

A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the communities we serve.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are dedicated to innovating and transforming the way we operate. As a key member of the Warehouse Transformation Team, the Senior Manager, Warehouse Equipment Platform Engineering will lead the development, engineering, and global standardization of warehouse automation equipment platforms. The role will establish reusable design principles, technical specifications, reference architectures, and performance standards for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS), four-way shuttle systems, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), robotic picking, goods-to-person picking, and automated truck loading. Working with our plants, cross-functional partners, external equipment suppliers, and system integrators, this leader will support concept development and detailed design for both greenfield facilities and brownfield modernization projects while balancing enterprise standards, site constraints, safety, scalability, and business value.

We seek an engineering leader who combines deep knowledge of warehouse equipment and material-flow design with strong platform thinking, supplier leadership, and the ability to convert operational needs into safe, reliable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions.

What You'll Do for Us

Own and govern the global catalog of warehouse equipment platforms, including approved technology options, reference configurations, and application criteria.
Develop and maintain technical standards, design guidelines, reference configurations, equipment specifications, and approved component strategies for AMRs, AS/RS, four-way shuttles, AGVs, robotic picking, goods-to-person systems, and automated truck loading.
Define platform requirements for safety, throughput, capacity, availability, reliability, and maintainability.
Partner with plants and project teams to translate operational demand, product flows, storage profiles, and service requirements into fit-for-purpose equipment concepts.
Support greenfield projects from concept development through detailed equipment design, technical acceptance, commissioning, and operational handover.
Support brownfield assessments and modernization strategies that account for existing infrastructure, operational continuity, phased implementation, installation constraints, and migration risk.
Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and engineering consultants through market assessment, solution development, technical evaluation, design reviews, factory and site acceptance, commissioning, and performance validation.
Support creation of reusable engineering tools, design templates, simulation inputs, test protocols, lessons learned, and governance processes that reduce project risk and accelerate deployment.
Monitor technology and supplier developments, qualify new solutions, and manage platform obsolescence and continuous improvement across the installed base.

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial, controls, systems, automation, or a related engineering field, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of engineering, design, deployment, or operational experience with warehouse automation and material-handling equipment.
Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following: AMR, AS/RS, four-way shuttle, AGV, robotic picking, goods-to-person, or automated truck-loading solutions.
Experience developing equipment specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, leading design reviews, and supporting commissioning and acceptance testing.
Working knowledge of warehouse software and controls integration, including WMS, WES, WCS, MES, PLCs, industrial networks, and equipment interfaces.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and align teams on strategic objectives and project outcomes.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and influence internal and external partners regarding standards, design decisions, risks, and recommended practices.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Plant Control
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

Why This Role Matters

A Fusion power plant only produces useful results if something can control it, observe it, and make sense of what it did. The means firmware on the controllers that fire the pulses, supervisory automation that coordinates the machine as a system, the network and infrastructure backbone, and data pipelines that capture events spanning nanoseconds to years. The machine and facility are first of their kind, which means the software is too.

You will lead and scale the team that builds it. This means more than just hiring the right people. It means establishing software engineering as a core functional discipline by creating processes that enable the team to do their best work and building the structure around how software and hardware teams interact at Helion.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and grow the Plant Control Software team, a multidisciplinary team across firmware, application software, networking, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Own delivery of the plant control software stack across its embedded, supervisory, networking, and data layers.
Partner closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fuel cycle, systems engineering, operations, and science. Our software ships against hardware on a shared schedule and the coordination across those boundaries is a core responsibility.
Establish the engineering principles that will be the foundation for this team as it grows including how it plans, reviews, tests, deploys, responds to faults, and hands off to operations.

Required Skills

10+ years of experience building complex control systems for hardware 3+ years of experience in a leadership role building and managing a multidisciplinary software team (software engineers, firmware/embedded engineers, with a diversity of level from early career to senior).
Depth in real-time, embedded, or control software for physical systems, sufficient to hold technical direction with a senior team.
A track record of delivering software against hardware on a shared schedule in an environment where the hardware is the product.
Experience hiring, and growing engineers over time.
The ability to work fluently across disciplinary boundaries with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, systems engineers, operators, and scientists.
A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families
31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days)
10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break
Up to 5% employer 401(k) match
Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance
Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks)
Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Architecture & Strategy

Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions across a cloud environment, including AWS and Databricks.

Collaborate with a highly motivated team to evaluate and integrate emerging technologies that enhance the capabilities of the data platform.

Ability to design and operate systems that scale across both traditional ML infrastructure and emerging agentic AI architectures.

Role summary

The Global Director, Software and Digital Strategy owns the multi-year strategy and commercial architecture for the combined software portfolio spanning both platforms — procedure planning, predictive modeling, treatment confirmation, remote capability, and outcomes data. Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies

Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes

Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services

Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales

jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity around the world for consumers and businesses. Across our leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp
– Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Intuit Customer Success (ICS) is evolving from a traditional support function into a core growth and experience engine for Intuit. As part of our AI-powered, services-led platform strategy, ICS orchestrates advanced AI capabilities and human expertise to deliver “done-for-you” experiences that drive revenue growth, deepen customer confidence, and strengthen long-term retention across the Intuit ecosystem. Powered by the world’s largest expert network and the Virtual Expert Platform (VEP)
, we are embedding AI + HI directly into the customer journey to create a durable competitive advantage.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an innovative, AI-native VP of Design
to provide executive leadership across ICS and VEP - the organization shaping how AI and human expertise work together to power a multi-billion-dollar services ecosystem and unlock an incremental $10B growth opportunity for Intuit.

This leader will ensure that our capabilities are delivered as a coherent platform while enabling high-impact, end-to-end service experiences through world-class service design. You will lead an integrated design organization spanning platform product design and service design—along with research, design technology, operations, and design labs - aligning platform capability development, embedded service experiences, and go-to-market strategy into a unified system that drives adoption and growth.

This isn’t just a leadership role; it is an opportunity to architect the future of AI-powered, expert-driven financial services and redefine how millions of customers access trusted expertise by leading the platform design for the intersection of AI + HI.

Responsibilities

Platform Product Design: Lead the design for the core capabilities used widely across the Intuit ecosystem by both customers and experts.

Vision & Strategy: Champion a bold, long-term vision for customer and experience experiences.
Design at Scale: Lead a massive design organization in building component libraries and design systems that power innovation across all Intuit offerings.
ICS Expert Studio Oversight: Oversee the Expert Studio that supports service adoption, business growth, and deep customer understanding.
Influence & Partner: Act as a strategic partner to key stakeholders across every segment of Intuit, balancing short-term execution with long-term Design-driven innovation.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and ICS leaders to define strategy and deliver end-to-end (E2E) experiences.
Inspire and Coach: Lead and grow a high-performance culture of designers, fostering a culture of innovation, creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Impact & Key Metrics

Platform Adoption: Measure the usability and effectiveness of VEP-powered experiences embedded across Intuit products.
Growth Outcomes: Drive increased customer engagement, confidence, and adoption of expert-led services.
AI + HI Effectiveness: Improve customer resolution rates and expert productivity through optimized AI-powered workflows.
Experience Quality: Deliver measurable improvements in clarity and consistency across all ICS service journeys.

Qualifications

We are looking for a dynamic, passionate leader who can thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment.

Platform Leadership: Deep experience designing and scaling end-to-end platform experiences that connect multiple products into a unified ecosystem, anchored by strong design systems.
Service Design: Lead service design experiences, tying together the entire ecosystem and all the invisible strings that make a customer’s experience work.
Design Craft & Holistic Design Approach: You bring a passion for design excellence, valuing interaction, visual, content, motion, and research - and know how to unify them into cohesive systems.
Customer-Obsession: You anchor strategy in customer needs and outcomes, balancing vision with measurable impact.
Strategic Leadership & Influence: Comfortable influencing across all levels of the organization with both, well-informed perspectives.
AI & Conversational Mastery: Familiarity with web, mobile, and conversational technologies and how they impact the feasibility of AI-driven design solutions.

Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Job Description Summary

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are dedicated to innovating and transforming the way we operate. As a key member of the Warehouse Transformation Team, the Senior Manager, Warehouse Equipment Platform Engineering will lead the development, engineering, and global standardization of warehouse automation equipment platforms. The role will establish reusable design principles, technical specifications, reference architectures, and performance standards for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS), four-way shuttle systems, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), robotic picking, goods-to-person picking, and automated truck loading. Working with our plants, cross-functional partners, external equipment suppliers, and system integrators, this leader will support concept development and detailed design for both greenfield facilities and brownfield modernization projects while balancing enterprise standards, site constraints, safety, scalability, and business value.

We seek an engineering leader who combines deep knowledge of warehouse equipment and material-flow design with strong platform thinking, supplier leadership, and the ability to convert operational needs into safe, reliable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions.

What You'll Do for Us

Own and govern the global catalog of warehouse equipment platforms, including approved technology options, reference configurations, and application criteria.
Develop and maintain technical standards, design guidelines, reference configurations, equipment specifications, and approved component strategies for AMRs, AS/RS, four-way shuttles, AGVs, robotic picking, goods-to-person systems, and automated truck loading.
Define platform requirements for safety, throughput, capacity, availability, reliability, and maintainability.
Partner with plants and project teams to translate operational demand, product flows, storage profiles, and service requirements into fit-for-purpose equipment concepts.
Support greenfield projects from concept development through detailed equipment design, technical acceptance, commissioning, and operational handover.
Support brownfield assessments and modernization strategies that account for existing infrastructure, operational continuity, phased implementation, installation constraints, and migration risk.
Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and engineering consultants through market assessment, solution development, technical evaluation, design reviews, factory and site acceptance, commissioning, and performance validation.
Support creation of reusable engineering tools, design templates, simulation inputs, test protocols, lessons learned, and governance processes that reduce project risk and accelerate deployment.
Monitor technology and supplier developments, qualify new solutions, and manage platform obsolescence and continuous improvement across the installed base.

Requirements & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial, controls, systems, automation, or a related engineering field, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of engineering, design, deployment, or operational experience with warehouse automation and material-handling equipment.
Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following: AMR, AS/RS, four-way shuttle, AGV, robotic picking, goods-to-person, or automated truck-loading solutions.
Experience developing equipment specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, leading design reviews, and supporting commissioning and acceptance testing.
Working knowledge of warehouse software and controls integration, including WMS, WES, WCS, MES, PLCs, industrial networks, and equipment interfaces.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and align teams on strategic objectives and project outcomes.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and influence internal and external partners regarding standards, design decisions, risks, and recommended practices.

Purpose Driven: Purpose driven approach that empowers our people to protect the environment and communities we serve while delivering safe & quality products.
Global Connections: Allows you to develop, enhance and maintain global connections that allow us to move faster and learn from others.
Community of Belonging: We’re an organization that believes our ability to continually grow and build the right atmosphere where people feel safe and empowered, lets you bring your best self to work.

Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.
